title: Signage icons

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Use familiar pictograms so people can interpret directions without relying entirely on language.
strategic_value: Standard-based icons can help Helsinki wayfinding serve visitors with different language backgrounds.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture pairs a short rationale and standards requirement with a grid of familiar service, safety and access icons.
practical_value: Use the supplied originals and international-standard meanings rather than inventing a new symbol for a familiar service.

content_islands.name: Icon rationale and links
content_islands.spec: Keep the language-access rationale with standards and source links.

content_islands.name: Pictogram grid
content_islands.spec: Show the mixed service and safety symbols below, including their distinct shapes and colors.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says visual information is easier to understand and works across language barriers.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Signage icons must be designed according to international standards.
reference_purposes.Expression: The grid shows service and safety symbols with familiar silhouettes.
